correctness.rationale: Competing exponential reset and Brownian hitting time gives F(s)=(r+s)I(r+s)/(s+rI(r+s)), I(v)=E exp(-distance sqrt(v/D)). Fixing mean (1-p)/(rp) fixes only p=I(r), not I(r+s). With U=e^{-sqrt(r/D)distance} and alpha=sqrt(1+s/r)>1, strict Jensen and the endpoint chord prove sharp simultaneous lower/upper transform envelopes. Differentiating at zero gives Var(T)=[1-p^2+E U log U]/(r^2p^2), same unique minimizing and maximizing distance distributions by convexity. Inverting F and uniqueness of Laplace transforms proves iff law identifiability up to reflection. Independently checked exact two-distribution witness and finite frequency inequalities; analytic proof handles all laws.
